title: Simple Cantaloupe Smoothie (Community Enhanced)
ingredients: 4 ice cubes, crushed, or as needed
instructions: Process yogurt, orange juice, more cantaloupe, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth, about 30 seconds.

source_review.text: Used vanilla Greek yogurt (what I had on hand)t, added a few more ice cubes and ended up with a really creamy breakfast smoothie. I had a perfectly ripe cantaloupe and just eyeballed the amount, adding a more than 1/2 cup I'd say, but the OJ still slightly overpowered the cantaloupe flavor. Didn't really matter that much, as it was perfectly sweet, and I enjoyed it.
